While there were serious adverse events (maculopapular rash, cholecystitis, gallbladder infection) occurring in 20% of patients each, these were manageable and allowed for MTD determination. The trial also showed preliminary efficacy signals with 20% ORR and 3.7 month PFS. Since this is a Phase I safety/dose-finding study that met its primary safety endpoint, it should be classified as successful. The lack of biomarker data prevents assessment of target engagement, but this is typical for Phase I trials focused on safety rather than mechanistic validation.
